title: KDB
description: config.ini [KDB] section (KDBConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

kdb_only.description: Only use KDB in an AKMC simulation, no random searches.

remove_duplicates.description: KDB will not make duplicate suggestions. This can slow KDB querying, so it may be best to use this only for slow potentials (DFT, etc.).

kdb_name.description: Unused name kept so old ini files still parse. The catalog directory is Paths.kdb.

kdb_nf.description: Neighbor fudge, a fraction. The match tolerance is kdb_dc * (1 + kdb_nf) angstroms.

kdb_dc.description: Distance cutoff in angstroms. A stored reactant whose atoms sit farther than kdb_dc * (1 + kdb_nf) from the current state is not a match.

kdb_mac.description: Minimum absolute cosine between the stored mode and the reactant-to-saddle displacement. At or above this value the refine uses the stored mode. Below it, the refine uses the reactant-to-saddle vector.
